name: MATH
description: A dataset of 12,500 challenging competition mathematics problems, spanning seven subject areas and five difficulty levels, with step-by-step solutions.
citation: Hendrycks, D., Burns, C., Kadavath, S., et al. (2021). Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 34. https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03874

license.notes: The upstream repository provides an MIT license; source problem statements may have separate rights, so review their provenance and terms before redistribution.
